author: Discovery
description:
Watch as winter brings heavy snow, icy roads and freezing temperatures to the Rocky Mountains, making it harder for drivers and tow crews to get around! A huge pileup near the Eisenhower Tunnel leaves dozens of vehicles stuck, while Big Jon heads into the mountains to rescue a semi trapped in the snow, and more! 
#Discovery #RockyMountainWreckers
